title: Four damage to the face of the player on four
briefing: P1 has four Mountains and Stoke the Flames (4 damage to any target). P2 is at 4 life, no creature is threatening anyone, and the table has several creatures to shoot instead. The only winning play is Stoke to P2's face; a player that only aims burn at creatures never takes it.

reference.analysis: Stoke the Flames deals 4 to any target. P2 is at exactly 4, so it is a kill. Aimed at the Strix or the Wall it only removes a creature.

options.label: Stoke the Flames at P2
options.why: Four damage at a player on four: P2 is eliminated.

otherwise.why: P2 survives; the burn is wasted or spent on a creature.
